item_name: Rothco Deluxe Navy Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Show your support for the United States Navy with Rothco’s Deluxe Navy Low Profile Cap. Made of 100% brushed cotton twill, the baseball hat features raised embroidered "Navy" text on the front panel and upper brim, woven "Navy" labels, and adjustable hook and loop closure. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions.
